# Day01 R Learning Diary

## Today's Study Info
- Study Duration: 40 minutes
- Module: RStudio interface, variable assignment, basic calculation, logical operation

## Core Knowledge Points
1. Two assignment operators in R: <- (recommended) and =
2. Basic arithmetic: + - * / ^ for square
3. R can store numeric and character variables
4.Logical operator > < == returns TURE / FALSE
5. Command ls() can check all variable in global environment

## Runable R Code Today
```{r}
# ========== Day01 R Basic Start ==========
# 1. Two assignment methods in R
a <- 10
b = 5

# 2. Basic arithmetic calculation
a + b   # Addition 
a - b   # Subtraction 
a * b   # Multiplication 
a / b   # Division 
a ^ 2   # Square 

# 3. Character / text variable
name <- "Clinical Psychology R Learning"
name

# 4. Logical judgement: return TRUE / FALSE
a > b
a < b
a == b

# 5. List all variables in environment
ls()
```
